diagram.manim_description: On a 16:9 canvas with a plain BG background draw the book's token rectangle, centred. A token is a disc of diameter 1.0 with a 2 px INK outline and a bold INK symbol centred in it: a plus sign on a green token (fill TOKEN_POS #5FB36B) and a minus sign on a red token (fill TOKEN_NEG #E8744F). One outer rounded rectangle (GUIDE outline 2 px, no fill) encloses two inner rounded rectangles that sit side by side with a gap of 0.4 (GUIDE outline 2 px, no fill). LEFT inner box (width 3.1, height 5.7): 8 green tokens in 4 rows and 2 columns, pitch 1.3 in both directions. RIGHT inner box (width 4.4, height 5.7): 12 red tokens in 4 rows and 3 columns, pitch 1.3 in both directions. Above the outer rectangle draw one INK curly brace spanning its full width, tip pointing up, with the label 4 × (2 + (−3)) centred above the tip. Below the outer rectangle draw two INK curly braces, tips pointing down: one spanning the left inner box with the label 4 × 2 under its tip, one spanning the right inner box with the label 4 × (−3) under its tip. Draw nothing else: no results, no equals sign, no totals, no zero pairs.

diagram.manim_description: On a 16:9 canvas with a plain BG background draw a token arrangement of 4 rows stacked top to bottom, row pitch 1.8, centred. A token is a disc of diameter 1.0 with a 2 px INK outline and a bold INK symbol centred in it: a minus sign on a red token (fill TOKEN_NEG #E8744F) and a plus sign on a green token (fill TOKEN_POS #5FB36B). Every row has 5 tokens with centres at x = 0, 1.5, 3.3, 4.8 and 6.3: tokens 1 and 2 are red, tokens 3, 4 and 5 are green. That is 8 red and 12 green tokens in all. In every row draw two FOCUS dashed rounded rectangles (2.5 px): an inner one that encloses tokens 2 and 3 (padding 0.1) and an outer one that encloses tokens 1 to 4 (padding 0.25), so each row shows 2 zero pairs, 8 zero pairs in all; token 5 of each row (a green token) stays outside both outlines. To the right of the arrangement draw one ANSWER-coloured bracket that spans the 4 unpaired green tokens (token 5 of rows 1 to 4) and put the label = 4 in ANSWER next to it. Above the arrangement draw one INK curly brace spanning all 5 columns, tip pointing up, with the label −4 × (2 + (−3)) above the tip. Below the arrangement draw two INK curly braces, tips pointing down: one spanning columns 1 and 2 with the label (−4) × 2 under its tip and one spanning columns 3 to 5 with the label (−4) × (−3) under its tip. Draw nothing else.
must_not_show: the words zero pair, cancel or left
accuracy_checks: 4 rows × 2 red tokens = 8 red tokens; 4 rows × 3 green tokens = 12 green tokens
each row is the inverse of 2 + (−3): 2 reds and 3 greens, and the multiplier −4 gives 4 such rows
2 zero pairs per row (token 2 with 3, token 1 with 4), 4 × 2 = 8 zero pairs in all
unpaired tokens: 12 greens − 8 reds = 4 greens, one per row (token 5), matching the tag = 4
diagram.alt_text: Four rows of 2 red and 3 green tokens; 8 zero pairs are outlined and 4 green tokens are left over, tagged = 4.
diagram.render_note: The book's Try This (p.18) prints no answer picture; this is the token rectangle the LP solution describes (inverse of 2 + (−3) added 4 times). Same layout idea as base P18-integer_tokens-1 but without its inner boxes, because the zero-pair outlines cross the gap between reds and greens.
